text:
Maya Chen: thinking of doing something a bit different this Friday — neon bocce + snacks at The Alley? 5:30pm start, casual. vibes: glow sticks, easy parking. who’s in? :bocce_ball: :tada:
Ravi Patel: love this. bocce court available until 8? sounds perfect. count me in. :thumbsup:
Chris O'Neill: hell yeah. can we get a table for food near the court? bringing a friend — is that ok?
Maya Chen: @Chris O'Neill friends welcome, just add them to the RSVP. i'll reserve a small table. thinking chips/sandwich platters + one veg option. any dietary needs?
Lena Gomez: i'm in! vegetarian here — salad or hummus pls. also can we do a short poll for drink prefs? some folks prefer non-alcoholic options.
Jordan Park: i vote mocktails + a couple pitchers of lager. parking note: garage across 3rd is free after 6. might be tight earlier.
Ravi Patel: fwiw i'll be biking, so rack space would be good to know.
Maya Chen: good call re mocktails. menu plan: 2 sandwich platters (1 veg), snack platter, chips, and 2 mocktail pitchers + 2 beer pitchers. cost split? i can take initial tab and we Venmo.
Chris O'Neill: sounds fair. how many people should i add for my +1?
Maya Chen: add 1 for now. current rough tally: Maya, Ravi, Chris(+1), Lena, Jordan = 6. opsbot, can you create a quick RSVP reminder in #lunch-plans tomorrow? @OpsBot
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled — will post 48h and 12h before event in #lunch-plans. (action: create RSVP thread) :robot_face:
Lena Gomez: also can we make it family-friendly? might bring my partner if that's ok.
Maya Chen: absolutely family-friendly. last thing: dress code — neon encouraged but optional :neon:
metadata_note: Single-thread Slack export. Messages are chronological, prefixed by sender name. No title included per agents.md.
